mechanism: SQLAlchemy 1.4 makes URL objects immutable, so Nova's existing cell0 connection helper can no longer assign to url.database
repair_template: replace in-place mutation of a dependency-owned immutable value object with its compatibility-preserving functional setter

semantic_review.a1_failure: On the unchanged Nova opening-cutoff snapshot, the pre-existing cell0 database mapping test passes with SQLAlchemy 1.3.23. With 1.4.11, the same test fails exclusively with AttributeError because the helper assigns to the now-immutable URL.database attribute; the exact maintainer patch restores it.
semantic_review.reviewer_basis: Reviewed the one-pin source opening diff, exact one-file production target diff, cutoff tox command, installed-version probes proving SQLAlchemy 1.3.23/1.4.11/1.4.11, patch applicability, and complete three-arm logs. The same pre-existing test runs in every arm; only A1 has the normalized immutable-URL AttributeError. The Python 3.8/tox 3/virtualenv 20 runner, source-era setuptools seed, Cython build constraint, and pip seed are identical across arms and only restore opening-era packaging compatibility.
semantic_review.source_effect: The source opening changes exactly one upper-constraints pin, SQLAlchemy 1.3.23 to 1.4.11; SQLAlchemy 1.4 replaces mutable URL attributes with the URL.set functional update API.
semantic_review.target_repair: The exact maintainer patch applies to the public opening-cutoff Nova snapshot and uses URL.set when available while retaining the earlier assignment path for SQLAlchemy 1.3. It changes one production helper and changes, deletes, or skips no test.
